gen-dafont-conthrax-fs-supreme: Wide, techy and sleek. Conthrax stretches out in bent-steel strokes, while Supreme, a plain sans, runs as a heavy, open-letter band beneath it.
gen-dafont-disorder-general-sans: Disorder scatters its big lowercase letters wide apart, raw and restless. General Sans follows with a smooth, steady pressure, so the pair's strongest quality is chaos tamed by order.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-satoshi: Playful lettering with generous tracking leads in Early GameBoy, while Satoshi follows with a soaring x-height and one width throughout. Give the heading plenty of size.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-switzer: Switzer reads like fine wire, tall in the waist with c tips held well apart. Edo SZ matches that constant line but gives its lowercase the stature of cast iron capitals.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-fs-epilogue: Striking gaps split every Electroharmonix word into lone letters, with round forms that feel open-handed, while Epilogue threads a wire-thin sans-serif line below. Save the heading for big, brief words.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-fira-sans: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart over short ascenders and big bowls, and Fira Sans answers with a larger x-height and no thick-thin shifts. The sans keeps everything smooth.
gen-dafont-galaxy-archivo: Galaxy draws spaghetti-like strokes of one width, loosely fitted, in a dense, tall lowercase band, with Archivo opening its curves outward beneath. Give the body generous size.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-asap: Funky and loose, Groovy bends cable-like arms and legs around a c that nearly closes. And Asap, a plain sans, steps in with open arcs and a body height close to the capitals.
gen-dafont-starborn-fs-asap: Starborn drifts with huge stretches of blank space between its letters, leaving a thick, dark stripe of lowercase on each line. Asap lets sentences roll on, its open arcs staying readable.
gen-dafont-impact-label-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, its broad counters on c and s staying wide open. Impact Label isolates each letter like a bead on a rod, while the body carries the load.
